title: Bridging AI and Child Development: A Comparative Study of Hallucinations in LLMs and Children's Cognitive Errors

contributions.purpose: 提出跨学科框架理解LLM幻觉
contributions.mechanism: 把LLM/文生视频的错误与儿童认知发展错误类比(物理常识、空间推理、心智理论三维度)
contributions.evaluation: 定性:识别出两者在过度泛化、来源混淆、先验偏见植入上的重叠模式,无实证实验
contributions.source_quote: We propose a comparative analysis, drawing direct parallels between the errors exhibited by advanced AI systems and the cognitive development of children.

contributions.purpose: 借鉴儿童发展策略提出幻觉缓解方向
contributions.mechanism: 映射地面真值反馈、批判性思维、认知强制干预、人在环、XAI透明化等到LLM训练
contributions.evaluation: 定性概念性建议,未实现或评测;自承人工反馈微调劳动密集且难扩展,认知强制干预可能加剧不平等
contributions.source_quote: insights gleaned from the field of child psychology... can provide valuable strategies for improving AI accuracy and transparency.

contributions.purpose: 梳理伦理影响与未来方向
contributions.mechanism: 讨论误导信息、偏见放大、劳动影响、信任侵蚀,并提出用儿童说谎类型学细分幻觉、构建计算模型
contributions.evaluation: 定性综述性论述,无量化结果
contributions.source_quote: LLM inaccuracies might similarly be categorized... differentiating between confabulations that stem from knowledge gaps, those designed to be intentionally misleading...

notes: 纯概念/立场论文,无实验(paper checklist问4-8均答NA,自称'conceptual study')。协议适配问题:本文无编号贡献列表,四元组由abstract+conclusion归纳,evaluation字段无数字(定性论文如实描述)。红旗:AI Involvement Checklist自相矛盾——问2实验设计答[D]称'AI autonomously executed the experiments',问3数据分析答[D]称'automatically generated statistical analyses and visualized the data in figures',但全文无任何实验/图表/数据,paper checklist却承认无实验。此为模板化AI自评与实际内容脱节的痕迹。无负结果。综述堆砌68篇引用但多为泛泛援引。
